2.  25-54079  Recommendation to discuss strategies to enhance community engagement with
  the City of Long Beach, including hosting listening sessions to gather input and
  identify community needs.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Lara, seconded by Commissioner
  Gillette, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.

  A substitute motion was made by Chair Covington, seconded by Vice Chair
  Batts, to collaborate with the Office of Equity to develop listening sessions,
  focused on four identity groups: Black and African American in February,
  Latine/x/o and Native American in March, Asian Pacific Islander and
  Southeast Asian in April, and LGBTQ+ in May, to be held in the Civic
  Chambers, and/or other available locations; the Office of Equity staff and the
  Commission Chair will coordinate the key elements of the listening sessions.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  9 De Leon, Gillette, Koll, Lara, Montgomery, Samé-Weil, Schultz, Batts,
  Covington
  No:  3 Butler, McNeill, Shaw-Malone
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 2 Flores, Lissette Flores
